dimensions.assessment: Affects synthetic nucleic acid providers, researchers, institutions of higher education, and customers participating in the consortium.
dimensions.evidence: convened a consortium of stakeholders, including industry, institutions of higher education, nonprofit organizations, and customers

dimensions.assessment: Primarily procedural and standard-setting effects focused on research, guidelines, and risk management best practices.
dimensions.evidence: carry out measurement research to support the development and improvement of best practices and technical standards

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes an appropriation of $5,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031 for NIST activities.
dimensions.evidence: there is authorized to be appropriated $5,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Research and Development, Competition, and Innovation Act to incorporate specific biosecurity research and reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: Section 10221 of the Research and Development, Competition, and Innovation Act... is amended

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes multi-year funding spanning five fiscal years and mandates ongoing consortium reporting.
dimensions.evidence: authorized to be appropriated $5,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031

missing_information: Broader economic effects outside of the specified NIST funding allocations are not detailed.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs NIST to support nucleic acid screening standards, form a stakeholder consortium, and authorizes specific funding appropriations.
